The wind had carried a rumor of something older—something that had been sitting on the edge of a balcony, listening to the same melody that had danced through the years.  

It began with a story. A simple one, yes—two strangers, one in a velvet hat, the other in a threadbare coat, met on a rain-slicked balcony at the edge of a music festival. They were not meant to be held, nor were they meant to be shared. They were meant to *feel*.
